root_cause_statement: Ultralytics/YOLO26 training on this machine fails because any spatial BatchNorm (BatchNorm2d, BatchNorm3d, BatchNorm1d with 3D input) executed through MIOpen triggers runtime compilation of an embedded spatial-BatchNorm kernel (MIOpenBatchNormFwdTrainSpatial.cpp / MIOpenBatchNormFwdInferSpatial.cpp) via HIPRTC, and that compilation aborts with HIPRTC_ERROR_COMPILATION (6) because miopen_type_traits.hpp:151's #include <type_traits> cannot be resolved: no C++ standard library exists at any searched location on the machine and the ROCm Windows wheels ship none for their msvc-target clang toolchain.
key_pass_controls: Matrix B (CPU BN), E (BN with cudnn disabled - diagnostic), F (Conv), H (autograd)
key_fail_experiments: Pure PyTorch BatchNorm2d eval - MIOpenBatchNormFwdInferSpatial (evidence/raw/batchnorm/matrix_results.json case C)

unresolved_hypotheses.H10_missing_host_msvc_stl: plausible - type_traits physically absent machine-wide; sufficiency unproven (no VS to A/B)
unresolved_hypotheses.H11_wheel_packaging_include_path: plausible - wheels ship no C++ STL; AMD Windows docs declare no MSVC prerequisite
unresolved_hypotheses.H8_python313: falsified by external evidence only (MIOpen #3956 on 3.12.7)
unresolved_hypotheses.H9_gfx1151_specific: falsified by external evidence only (#3956 on gfx1200)

upstream_correlation.miopen_3956: same error signature field-for-field in compiler diagnostics; still open/unanswered
upstream_correlation.rocm_libraries_2169: DIFFERENT compile-stage defect (gfx1151 DPP inline-asm, fixed by PR #1288); its Windows log compiled past the full include chain, unlike the ROCm 7.14 rockrel wheels - a Phase-2 packaging-difference lead

type_traits_status: ABSENT - physically missing at every searched location (no MSVC/LLVM/gcc STL found; none in either ROCm wheel tree)
workaround_status: none proposed; torch.backends.cudnn.enabled=False observation is diagnostic only
